name: testing-refused-call
description: A call that the host refuses fails with the message of the refusal: the clipboard read serves text and file URLs only.
reason: The calls of this case other than runtime.log are answered by the page of the workbench, which only a running application has; the runtime.log steps are replayed by the cases log-clock and log-batch.

reply.error: view call runtime.clipboard.read image is not served
